description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.


We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.


You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.


The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
* Credibility and presence to hold governance with senior stakeholders on both sides, and to represent the business well.
* Solid grounding in contact\-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, customer satisfaction and quality, so you can coordinate meaningfully and interrogate the numbers.
* Comfort working with delivery data and reporting tools, and manipulating such data to be presented in a variety of formats to varying stakeholders of varying seniority
* Experience with Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/CCaaS customer service platform(s).
* Ability to create trust, maintain clarity, and build a one\-team relationship with an outsourcing partner while keeping accountability clear.
* Experience working in global teams \& managing stakeholders across geographies.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience standing up or transitioning outsourced engagement, with exposure to commercial negotiations and management.
* A project or programme management background, for example PMP certification.
Experience across multiple regions and product areas.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn.
